confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Phnom Penh; no live menus, booking pages or current listings were checked. Beer, coffee and inexpensive-meal anchors are the most reliable. The midrange meal (assumes VAT and service on the bill) and the accommodation tiers carry wider uncertainty, roughly 25 to 35 percent either way. Cocktail and wine are anchored to the local draught-beer relationship because direct knowledge is weak. July is low season, so accommodation may sit toward the lower end of typical rates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Southeast Asian basis, loosely benchmarked against other mid-sized Southeast Asian capitals with similar visitor price tiers, such as Hanoi and Vientiane; no single comparable city supplied exact figures. City anchors are model estimates from general knowledge, not from web search.
